build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable MoE experts and composition embedding for molecular property prediction
merge_mole_model_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MoE layers into a single Linear layer for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific expert heads using MOLE layers
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares a single head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
set_mole_coefficients: set MoE expert mixing coefficients using atomic numbers, batch indices, and CSD mixed embeddings for routing
